title: claim_continue_link_send's new erased_at guard has no test — erasure's email-side tombstone half is unpinned
evidence:
WHERE vacancy_id = $1::uuid
  AND email = lower($2)
  AND submitted_at IS NULL
  AND erased_at IS NULL
  AND (
    last_link_sent_at IS NULL
    OR last_link_sent_at < now() - interval '10 minutes'
  )
detail: Round 2 added this arm (round-1 SQL lacked it). Without it a still-open tab's continue-link POST after a confirmed erasure re-mints a token and sends real email to the erased applicant. All four claim tests (draft_integration_test.gleam:172/240/833/889) use live drafts; only the upsert-side erased guard is pinned (save_after_erasure_is_silently_rejected_test).
recommended_fix: Add an integration test: seed draft, erase via handle_erasure_delete, then claim_continue_link_send for the same (vacancy, email) must return zero rows and continue_token must stay NULL.

title: New public draft endpoints: negative-path matrix (malformed JSON 400, unknown vacancy 404 JSON, continue-link invalid email 400) untested
detail: Every integration test posts well-formed JSON to seeded vacancy codes; the only 400 pinned is save's invalid email and the only 404 is resume's unknown token. The decoder-error 400 (both handlers), unknown-code 404 JSON (lookup_accepting_vacancy), and continue-link's invalid-email 400 have no negative tests.
recommended_fix: Add three cheap handler-level tests: malformed JSON body -> 400 on /draft and /continue-link; unknown short_code -> 404 with ok:false; invalid email on /continue-link -> 400.

title: Round-2 'What stays' tombstone disclosure on the draft-erasure confirm page is unpinned (application-erasure sibling has a pin)
evidence:
html.section([], [
            html.h2([], [html.text("What stays")]),
            html.ul([], [
              html.li([], [
                html.text(
                  "Just your email address, until the vacancy closes — so a browser tab you left open can't quietly re-save the draft you just deleted. Then it's gone too.",
                ),
detail: This applicant-facing GDPR disclosure justifies keeping the email as a suppression record — the load-bearing W3 tombstone explanation. The only confirm-page assertion is the form testid (draft_integration_test.gleam: simulate.read_body(confirm) |> string.contains("draft-erasure-confirm-form")); erasure_view_test.gleam:41 pins the same 'What stays' block for the application-erasure page.
recommended_fix: Extend draft_erasure_confirms_then_deletes_test's confirm-page assertions with string.contains("What stays") and a key phrase from the retention justification.

title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
detail: P0 (briefing acceptance: draft round-trip, token auth/uniform-404/scoping, expiry sweep, erasure, strip-on-submit through real handle_post_form) = 100% FULL. P1 (abuse bounds + tombstone guards + reminder seam + middleware/csrf policy) ~85%: cap, fan-out, cooldown value, clear-rearm, save-side tombstone, body-size matrix, CSRF, redaction, PostHog scrub all pinned, but the erased-claim guard is NONE and the stage-2 recipient->continue-URL mapping closure in inbound_handler stays unpinned (round-1 W8 residual; SQL + template halves pinned). Overall ~92% of ~49 traced behaviors FULL. Band: P0 100%, P1 80-89%, overall >=80% -> CONCERNS.
recommended_fix: Pin claim_continue_link_send's erased-draft rejection and extract the send_reminders_background recipient->continue-URL mapping into a pure, unit-tested function; that lifts P1 above 90% (PASS).
